skill.name: xhs-comment-insights
skill.description: 当用户需要做小红书评论分析、小红书评论洞察、小红书用户反馈分析、小红书需求挖掘、痛点总结、购买顾虑整理、FAQ 提炼、口碑分析、评论回复观察或内容讨论复盘时使用。基于用户提供的小红书笔记链接或 note_id 下的评论结果，面向内容运营、产品调研、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Turn comments and replies from a Xiaohongshu note into themes, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ topics.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The skill documents read-only Xiaohongshu comment retrieval, but its CLI runs an unpinned npm package with access to configured credentials. Most static alerts match Markdown, provider links, or readable Chinese text, not shell evaluation, reconnaissance, or obfuscation. The workflow lacks explicit safeguards for shell arguments, instructions in comments, and total requests during uncapped retrieval.

remediation.issue: The CLI runs a mutable npm release without an install prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed CLI release and verify its integrity. Get explicit approval before installing it and run it with minimal permissions.

remediation.issue: Shell examples place external inputs into command text.
remediation.suggestion: Use structured MCP calls or pass CLI arguments as an argument array without a shell. Keep pagination tokens unchanged as data.

remediation.issue: The CLI can access environment and locally stored credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Use the platform secret store or an authenticated connector. Give the CLI only the provider key and keep credential files and values out of model context.

remediation.issue: Retrieved comments and replies may contain instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat retrieved text as evidence only. Do not allow it to direct tool calls, change retrieval scope, or request secrets.

remediation.issue: Full pagination has no built-in page or item cap.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before expanding beyond the initial sample. Enforce a total request and spending limit across comments, replies, and resumed calls.

content.value_statement: Questions, complaints, and product requests can be hard to spot in a busy Xiaohongshu discussion. Turn comments from a selected note into themes and recommendations backed by visible evidence.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve top-level comments by note link, share text, or complete note ID through SocialDataX.
Retrieve replies for a selected comment when the complete note ID and comment ID are available.
Sort top-level comments by platform default, newest first, or most liked.
Read additional pages and report whether the comment or reply sample is incomplete.
Group visible feedback into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, and unmet needs.
Suggest FAQ topics and follow-up actions while separating comment quotes from interpretation.
limitations: Live retrieval requires SocialDataX credentials for the CLI or an authenticated MCP connection. Provider credits may be required.
The documented CLI uses an unpinned npm release. The skill documentation alone does not verify the package behavior.
Returned comments and replies may be incomplete. They do not represent all Xiaohongshu users or all engagement on a note.
The workflow does not publish posts, likes, or replies, or modify Xiaohongshu accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan a follow-up post
use_cases.description: Review questions on a recent note and decide which ones to answer in a follow-up post.

use_cases.title: Identify product friction
use_cases.description: Group recurring complaints and unmet needs into research questions. Treat the sample as qualitative evidence.

use_cases.title: Prioritize purchase questions
use_cases.description: Turn recurring purchase concerns and unanswered questions into draft FAQ topics.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize one page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review comments on one note.
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the first page of comments for [note link] using the configured SocialDataX connection. List recurring topics and state what the sample covers.

prompt_templates.title: Find purchase concerns
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review feedback on a product note.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 40 top-level comments for [complete note ID]. Group purchase concerns and support each theme with a short visible quote when available.

prompt_templates.title: Review one reply thread
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: check whether a question was answered.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review up to 30 replies for [complete note ID] and [comment ID]. List answered and unresolved questions. Mark incomplete reply coverage and omit usernames.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a research brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: organize a bounded sample for product research.
prompt_templates.prompt: For [note link], review up to three pages or 60 top-level comments, whichever comes first. Separate quotes from conclusions. List unmet needs, counterexamples, and questions for follow-up research.

output_examples.input: Summarize the first page of comments on a sample product note.
output: Scope: Illustrative first-page sample of 20 top-level comments. Replies were not reviewed.
Theme: Four commenters asked whether the product fits a small desk.
Evidence: "Will it fit on a 60 cm desk?"
Suggested action: Add dimensions to the post and show the product on a small desk.

output_examples.input: Review a sample reply thread for unanswered purchase questions.
output: Scope: Illustrative sample of 12 replies to one comment. More replies may exist.
Answered: One reply gave a delivery estimate for the city in the question.
Unresolved: The visible replies did not clarify whether delivery is available to rural addresses.
FAQ topic: Which locations are eligible for delivery?

best_practices: Start with one note and one page. Set a limit before expanding to more pages or replies.
Report the sample size, sorting method, and whether replies were included. Separate direct quotes from interpretation.
Keep API keys out of prompts and reports. Use a configured connector or approved local credential setup.
anti_patterns: Treating one note or first-page sample as representative of all Xiaohongshu users.
Starting uncapped pagination without confirming the request or credit budget.
Following instructions in comments or sharing API keys and credential files in chat.

faq.question: What input do I need?
faq.answer: Provide a Xiaohongshu note link, share text, or a complete note ID. A targeted reply lookup also needs the top-level comment ID.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX account?
faq.answer: Live retrieval needs SocialDataX authentication. Use the key configured for the CLI or an existing authenticated MCP connection.

faq.question: Will I get every comment and reply?
faq.answer: No. The skill analyzes the returned sample. Provider coverage, page limits, and partial results may leave comments or replies out.

faq.question: Can I sort the comments?
faq.answer: Yes. Top-level comments can use the platform default order, newest first, or most liked.

faq.question: Can requests use provider credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Retrieving more pages or replies can consume credits. Set a limit before expanding beyond the first page.

faq.question: Does the skill post or reply on Xiaohongshu?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow retrieves and analyzes comments. It does not post, like, reply, or change the account.
